title: They Put a Tiny Guava in a Parrot Mold… Then THIS Happened 🦜🍈 #shorts #satisfying #diy
description:
Fruit-shaping molds can turn an ordinary piece of fruit into something that looks almost impossible to grow. The idea is simple — place a mold around a young fruit while it is still small, let the fruit continue growing inside the cavity, and the growing fruit gradually takes the shape of the mold.

For this experiment, a clear transparent parrot-shaped mold was carefully placed around a tiny green guava growing naturally on a guava tree. The mold was securely locked around the young fruit while it was still small, leaving the guava room to keep growing inside the unusual shape.

As the guava grows, it slowly fills the mold from the inside. Instead of staying round, the fruit gradually expands into the shape of the cavity, forming the body, head, curved beak, wings and long tail of a parrot.

What makes the experiment so satisfying is watching the tiny guava go from an ordinary round fruit into a completely unexpected shape. The transparent mold lets you see the fruit growing inside as it fills more and more of the parrot-shaped cavity.

Once the fruit has completely filled the mold, the locks are carefully released and the transparent mold is removed. The remaining plastic is cut away, revealing the finished green parrot-shaped fruit.

One small guava.
One transparent mold.
One unbelievable final shape. 🦜🍈

Same tree, same fruit, same growing process — just a completely different shape.
